summary: Ericsson filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly share repurchases under an existing buyback program announced April 16, 2026, running through March 31, 2027, for up to SEK 15 billion. During June 1-5, 2026, it repurchased 2,025,000 Class B shares at a weighted average price of SEK 124.57 per share, totaling about SEK 252 million. The repurchases were executed on Nasdaq Stockholm by Goldman Sachs Bank Europe SE. The Board intends to propose cancellation of shares (except those for incentive programs) at the 2027 AGM. This routine disclosure of open-market buybacks does not constitute a special situation; it's an ongoing capital return program. No premium, advisor, or structural complexity beyond standard safe-harbor compliance.
